{{Quote|We are not truly free, if it is simply given to us &mdash; we are only truly free if we have given it to ourselves. The Empire made us slaves, and now it is time for us to give ourselves our freedom. The time for revolt is now.|Drun Cairnwick|<ref name="GG6-1" />}}
Once tall and broad shouldered, '''Drun Cairnwick''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] freedom fighter in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and formerly a [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Escaping the fall of the Order during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Cairnwick became a member of the Rebel Alliance and a popular folk hero in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] born on [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]], Drun Cairnwick was just beginning his [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. When [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] betrayed the Jedi and issued [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to the Grand Army, which demanded the death of all Jedi, Cairnwick fled to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] following the arrest of his teachers. Setting a home for himself, Cairnwick spread anti-Imperial propaganda amongst his neighbors, becoming famous across the Cluster.<ref name="GG6-1" />

Over time, Cairnwick's propaganda led to the Adarlon people's desire to rebel against their [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] masters on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Incurring the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] wrath, Adarlon was besieged by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]; Cairnwick had fled his compound before it was laid waste by the Empire's forces. After having remained in hiding for several years, the rebel was captured by Imperial forces and secretly transported to the prison world of [[Gesaril]], where he stayed for more than a [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. During his time in the jail, the [[No-Holds-Barred]] barred organization had founded [[Cairn's Flying Circus]] as a way to search for Cairnwick without attracting Imperial curiosity.<ref name="GG6-1" />
{{RPGseed}}
Cairnwick was later rescued by the [[Cluster Navy]], an improvised fleet composed of independent [[Free-trader|free-traders]] that cooperated to attack [[Gesaril]]'s prison facility.<ref name="GG6-1" />
{{Endgame}}
